Title: Aarav's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Aarav - 10 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Zoya - 8 years, daughter
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair
3. Sunita - 35 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Aarav stands in the courtyard. Sunita stands near him.]

Aarav: "What lovely weather!"

[Aarav gives Mother a flower.]

Sunita: "Oh wow!"

[Lightning flashes across the sky.]

Aarav (softly): "Slowly, take it easy."

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Aarav stands in the living room. Zoya and Sunita stand near him.]

Sunita: "What a nice place."

[Aarav puts on his school uniform.]

Aarav: "Oh wow!"

[Zoya applies kajal to her eyes.]

Zoya: "How beautiful!"

[Aarav does his homework at the table.]

Aarav: "What a day to remember!"
